description: This file defines a React component for managing roles within a user interface, including listing roles, searching, editing, viewing permissions, and deleting roles. It includes subcomponents for displaying role details, permissions, and assigned users, utilizing Material-UI components and custom hooks.

methods.name: ViewPermissionsDrawer
methods.description: A drawer component that displays permissions for a specific role, fetching permissions data from API and highlighting assigned permissions.

methods.name: ShowRoleRow
methods.description: A component representing a row in the roles table, with functionalities to view assigned users, view permissions, edit, and delete roles, including nested drawers for details.

methods.name: filterUsers
methods.description: Filters roles based on search input.

methods.name: addNew
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new role.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit an existing role.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Opens dialog to view role details.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Deletes a role after user confirmation, with snackbar notifications for success or failure.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Refreshes role list after create/edit dialog is confirmed.

methods.name: Roles
methods.description: Main React component that manages the list of roles, including fetching data, search, and rendering role rows with actions.
